instruction: Configure GIMP to save EXIF data in exported images by enabling the 'Save EXIF data' option.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling EXIF data export via Edit > Preferences > Image Import & Export. The evaluator checks gimprc config file for '(export metadata-exif yes)' entry. Similar configuration task to the original.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement by checking GIMP's gimprc config file for '(export metadata-exif yes)' setting
Getter (get_gimp_config_file) correctly extracts the GIMP config file from standard location ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc
Metric (check_config_status) correctly parses GIMP's config format and matches the expected key-value pattern
Postconfig appropriately quits GIMP (Ctrl+Q) to ensure config changes are flushed to disk before verification
Expected value is semantically correct - '(export metadata-exif yes)' is the actual GIMP setting for enabling EXIF export
Complete coverage - instruction has single requirement (enable EXIF export) which is fully verified by the config check
